headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 413.1 Million Dollars As Binance Took In 416.2 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 413.1 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.1539 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 570.6 million dollars and 0.2127 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. Binance took in 416.2 million dollars, above the 413.1 million dollar net, while Bitfinex shed 61.4 million, Bybit shed 31.5 million, and Bitget shed 31.0 million.
author: jordan
